ns2:course.label: Topics in Applied Statistics
ns2:course.description: Formulation and analysis of mathematical models for random phenomena; extensive involvement with the analysis of real data; and instruction in statistical and computing techniques as needed. Same as MATH 468. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated with approval. prerequisite: STAT 410 or STAT 420; or consent of instructor.
